title: Maximum Level Sum of a Binary Tree
summary: For a given binary tree, determine the lowest level where the sum of node values is the greatest.
statement: For a given binary tree, determine the lowest level where the sum of node values is the greatest.
constraints: Return the smallest one-based level with maximum sum.

reference_solution:
def maximum_level_sum_depth(root):
 level=[root];depth=1;best_depth=1;best=float('-inf')
 while level:
  total=sum(node.val for node in level)
  if total>best:best=total;best_depth=depth
  level=[child for node in level for child in (node.left,node.right) if child];depth+=1
 return best_depth

hints: Breadth-first traversal naturally groups nodes by level.
Sum every current level before constructing the next one.
Update only on a strictly larger sum to preserve the smallest depth on ties.
Each node contributes once to exactly its own level total.
